clips.title: The story
paras: Thistlefuzz Arcanery is a prominent workshop and academy of the magical arts located east of the Great Forge in Ironforge. Run primarily by gnome practitioners, it serves as the capital's premier haven for enchanters and scholars seeking to weave magic into metal and parchment. Its busy chambers hum with arcane energy right alongside the roaring fires of dwarven industry.

Tucked directly east of the thundering Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery offers a stark contrast to the clanging anvils of dwarven smiths. Within its two levels, scholars, practitioners, and apprentices gather to master the subtle disciplines of enchanting and magical study. While the Ironforge dwarves prefer to reshape steel through muscle and fire, the gnomes of the Arcanery demonstrate how raw arcane energy can be bound directly into weaponry, armor, and curious tools. It stands as an essential sanctuary for spellcasters navigating the mountain stronghold.
